title: populus deltoides f. erecta
intro: Populus deltoides f. erecta, commonly known as Black Cottonwood or Eastern Cottonwood, is a deciduous tree species native to North America. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and act as an antimicrobial agent, making it a popular choice for treating various ailments such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Black Cottonwood include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. Additionally, the plant's bark and leaves have been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions due to their bioactive constituents, which have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
